title: proc field proc-tree path matching -- parent process chain patterns
desc: proc:'X/Y' finds windows whose process X was launched by Y. proc:'**/Y' finds all processes in Y's launch tree. Stops at shell/system boundary (explorer, svchost, dwm etc.).
steps: Simple proc:'nkrunlite' unchanged -- own process only (fast path)
proc:'**/wkappbot-core' -- all processes in wkappbot-core's launch tree
Stop list: explorer/svchost/dwm/services/lsass stops walk (avoids matching everything)
Score shows proc path: proc:'Code':1.00 (explorer stripped). GetProcPath depth=2 for display
Same MatchClassPath glob engine as cls path: ** zero-or-more segments, * single segment, each segment substring
author: claude
